name: JavaScript tour
description: ADR-0045: sandboxed JavaScript reshapes data that would be awkward in activities. It parses invoice lines, totals them per customer and builds a summary text. A script error is caught as ScriptError. Needs MyRPA.Scripting (see samples/plugins/README.md, all-plugins.json); for Python, set the plugin's pythonPath and use Code.Python the same way.
